_comment: Single source of truth for .github/workflows/build.yml, testsuite.yml and installers.yml (via .github/scripts/matrix.py).
images:         MATLAB-based images (docker/Dockerfile) with MATLAB and Octave from the base image's Ubuntu.
octave_supported=false: Dynare cannot be used with the Octave of that image (see octave_note); only the MATLAB testsuite runs.
octave_images:  Octave-only images (docker/Dockerfile.octave), tagged X.Y-octave; used for Dynare versions whose Octave requirements the MATLAB base images cannot meet.
installers:     official Dynare packages for Windows and macOS, tested natively on GitHub-hosted runners (no containers exist for these platforms).
schedule=monthly: rebuilt every month and tested weekly; schedule=manual: only built/tested on workflow_dispatch.
test_excludes:  meson test names (as printed by 'meson test --list' after ' / ') skipped for the given testsuite.

images.octave_note: Dynare 7 needs the Octave datatypes package, which requires Octave >= 9.1.0
